name: Repeated redundant card containers
summary: Use one surface per group and flat rows inside it; do not wrap each level in another card.
problem: A card inside a card inside a card, each with its own radius and shadow, adds weight without meaning and makes the elevation order ambiguous.

bad.description: Three nested cards with different surfaces and shadows around two member rows.

good.title: One surface, flat rows
good.description: A single panel, a muted heading and rows that fill on hover.

why: Removing wrappers is the simplest fix: hierarchy is carried by type and spacing, and the surface ramp stays readable.
exceptions: Each card in a grid of independent objects (a kanban card, a product tile) is a legitimate card when each is its own draggable or openable object.
A dialog or popover over a page is a separate layer, not a redundant card.

humanReview: Does each wrapper group something that needs grouping?
